methodology.truth: piecewise 0/5/10 through hand labels; zero=pin+leave-one-clip-out median signed rest shaft offset, unique frames only; phase does not override measured tip geometry
methodology.zeroDiagnostic: replace only zero in label scale with reader zero at matched frame; error is signed bias. Subtracting this from published bar is diagnostic, not a rerun or a shippable improvement
methodology.tip: last resolved shaft sample centre from pointerEvidence best candidate; source px includes endpoint extent error. Angular chord at labelled radius separately removes endpoint extent
methodology.repeats: 10 independent retaps of identical source frames; both upright source and display crop px; geometric bar difference without forcing rest to zero

ranking.name: Needle tracking across frames
ranking.expectedGaps: Largest direct opportunity: four needle-missing gaps / 52 unique frames; at most +7.69 coverage percentage points if all four are recovered. One pose-lost gap is outside this bound.
ranking.expectedSmoothness: Eight held + four missing observations are candidates for genuine fresh evidence: at most 12/52 = 23.08 percentage points of freshness. Avoid plateau/lag then catch-up jumps. No numeric jitter improvement established.
ranking.expectedMedian: Likely helps held-error tail more than median; eight held samples, maximum age 375 ms. A new quantitative median cannot be predicted from sparse labels.
ranking.risk: Medium/high: wrong-end identity, drift onto print or bezel, false certainty across occlusion. Prediction must never become measured pressure.
ranking.firstTicket: Add a behind-flag image-evidence tracker in registered dial coordinates; propagate prior tip/shaft and seek current-frame support, keep shaft-end identity, expire when support disappears. Preserve fresh/held/gap semantics and hold timeout. Run temporal clips, this frozen batch and one exam; no interpolation or relaxed safety gates.

ranking.name: Continuous session zero through countdown until pressure onset
ranking.expectedGaps: No demonstrated direct recovery of these five gaps: a scale offset does not supply a missing pointer or pose.
ranking.expectedSmoothness: Improves common baseline consistency; must freeze before first pressure movement. It cannot remove mid-shot needle gaps or smooth jitter by itself.
ranking.expectedMedian: Not demonstrated: median isolated zero bias 0.067 bar; diagnostic subtraction changes shown median 0.114 to 0.137 (worse). Some early 094055 frames have large zero error; benefits are clip- and range-specific, not additive to other fixes.
ranking.risk: Medium: early pressurisation may be erased as zero. b030/b039 tagged rest are geometrically above rest, so phase name/countdown time is not rest evidence. Session confirmation and fresh image stability must govern eligibility; trust taps and freeze zero at onset.
ranking.firstTicket: Collect confirmed-rest observations through the 3-2-1 countdown, estimate one robust session zero with uncertainty, then freeze at onset. Keep user 5/10 taps fixed. Add onset/false-rest/occlusion acceptance cases; no mid-shot rezero.

ranking.name: Tip geometric precision
ranking.expectedGaps: No demonstrated coverage gain from subpixel refinement alone. Off-scale/wrong-end cases need identity/evidence recovery, not endpoint polishing.
ranking.expectedSmoothness: Potential smaller reduction in fresh-sample jitter; current angular chord median 2.34 source px is close to repeat tip disagreement 2.63 source px. Physical endpoint length errors inflate full-distance metrics.
ranking.expectedMedian: Conditional tip geometry median |error| 0.091 bar versus repeat geometric disagreement 0.050 bar. These are different sample sets; subtracting them is not a forecast. A few hundredths bar may be worth testing, but no measured whole-reader median gain is established.
ranking.risk: Low/medium for refinement of a verified shaft; high if tuned on these 52 frames. Hub/tap noise and perspective can dominate. Avoid optimising the tip sample length when angular pressure is already correct.
ranking.firstTicket: Refine the centreline-to-pivot ray only after shaft identity is verified; report angular and transverse residuals independently of tip extent. Validate on held-out clips and repeats before touching acceptance thresholds.
